long_but_definitional.e8_quiet_without_reqs: Fourteen lines of ONE REWRITE AND PURE CASE EXHAUSTION: requirement membership is unfolded and rewritten by the hypothesis that the regime holds none, the membership is refuted by cases on the empty list, and each of the two conjuncts -- plain and flipped -- splits into its two disjuncts, each closed by that refutation or by False.  Its length measures the two symmetric conjuncts, not the amount of work, so the line bound is the wrong instrument here.  The exception is listed rather than the bound raised, so that it is visible and countable; test_census.py requires this list to stay at one entry.
